LanguageData.LP_OgreStature.label: ogre build
LanguageData.LP_OgreStature.description: The huge body of an ogre. Actual body size 160% of an ordinary person, drawn at 130% size, and hauls 10% more on top; eats 1.3× as much as normal, with a bigger stomach (giant stomach: max food ×160%). Giant-body rules give ogres total health ×130% and melee damage ×118%.
Actual body size: ×160% (multiplies with other body size effects).
Hauling capacity: another ×110% after rising with body size.
LanguageData.LP_OgreDull.label: dimwitted
LanguageData.LP_OgreDull.description: An ogre's mind turns slowly: research speed halved, often lowballed when trading, and more easily swayed by psychic means (mind resistance -10%, not below 0).
LanguageData.LP_SkinOgre.label: ogre skin
